threads.title: Head Auxetic Prestige MP-L - bring it to the US of A pls!
threads.body: Same mold and layup as the MP, 99 sq in, box beam, 21.5mm. Lighter setup, easy platform to customize, and great 16x19 pattern offer more power than the 18x19, more spin and still a great control. Great modern feel of the TGK334.5 layup, love it! i have modified it with 2+2g at 3&9, 3g at 12, TK82 pallets, 8g of silicone to 335g strung with OG, 31.7cm balance, 332SW. The frame is a killer! the PJ is beautiful, especially the classic glossy burgundy hoop.

threads.body: Boris was one of the best players I’ve ever seen and certainly one of the most complete, with a full arsenal of shots—serve, volley, smash, forehand, and backhand.
